verdict.rationale: A live probe shows Wave runs a public GraphQL endpoint (gql.waveapps.com/graphql/public) with introspection enabled, and the evidence identifies developer.waveapps.com as the documented home of that API. That makes the API Wave's own first-party capability. However, the portal returns 403 to crawlers, so no API documentation, scope, auth model, or supported operations could be verified, and the marketing pages document no API at all. Missing for 10: quotable first-party API documentation, evidence of auth and supported read/write operations, schema or SDL coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving real workflows via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: a live Apollo GraphQL server with introspection enabled
